sloka: त्रयाणामपि लोकानां कार्यार्थं मम सम्भवः ।भद्रं ते ऽस्तु गमिष्यामि यत एवाहमागतः ।। ७.१०४.१८ ॥
transliteration: trayāṇāmapi lokānāṁ kāryārthaṁ mama sambhavaḥ ।bhadraṁ te 'stu gamiṣyāmi yata evāhamāgataḥ ।। 7.104.18 ॥

translations.english: My existence is for the purpose of the three worlds; may good fortune be to you, I shall now depart to the place from where I came.
